stories.headline: US urges hands-off AI regulation at G20
stories.summary: The U.S. will press G20 members against creating new AI oversight bodies, favoring a pro-growth approach. Canada plans to emphasize public trust and safety, indicating that consensus is uncertain.

stories.headline: John Ternus succeeds Tim Cook as Apple CEO
stories.summary: John Ternus takes over Apple as Tim Cook becomes executive chairman. Apple grew enormously during Cook's tenure, but Ternus inherits pressure to improve its AI position and diversify manufacturing.

stories.headline: US officials accuse COSCO of maritime spying
stories.summary: Two U.S. officials allege that Chinese shipper COSCO uses concealed equipment to collect military communications. China's embassy called the allegations baseless; COSCO did not comment.

stories.headline: Renewed US-Iran strikes lift oil prices
stories.summary: Oil rose as renewed U.S.-Iran fighting revived supply concerns. Diplomacy over reopening the Strait of Hormuz remains inconclusive, and commercial traffic is still well below normal.

stories.headline: Newborn vitamin K refusals rise sharply in US
stories.summary: A review of more than one million births found hospital non-receipt of newborn vitamin K shots rose 57% during 2026's first half. The CDC still recommends the shot to prevent dangerous bleeding.
